nodes.title: SG-6 · Characters, animations, game state, dialogue, inventory and persistence
nodes.body:
Context: game/ already has a Zustand gameStore, pure systems (events, dialogue, inventory, interaction), localStorage persistence and boy spritesheets in the manifest, but nothing renders or animates characters, scene characters are not data-driven, opening choices have no outcomes, no action adds inventory items and the secret door object is not in the scene. Desired behavior: idle/walk/interact boy animations from the manifest, data-driven NPCs, the opening dialogue and choices progressing, contextual actions on bookshelf, computer, bed, window and door updating state, and persistent object states surviving leaving and re-entering the room. Expected result: unit tests cover action to state transitions, inventory, dialogue progression, persistence and restore and the secret door staying open. Why: playable state-driven adventure with no database.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the manifest, when a character spec is resolved for idle, walk and interact, then the matching manifest spritesheet animation is returned
- Given the opening scene, when it loads, then the dialogue reads "I don't know what to do next. What should we do?" with choices "Look around the room" and "Let's explore"
- Given a click action on bookshelf, computer, bed, window or door, when performed, then dialogue, choices, inventory or flags change in the store
- Given the secret door was opened, when the state is saved, restored or the scene is re-entered, then the door stays open
- Given persistence, then only localStorage is used and no database is added


## Scope
- In scope: Character and NPC content schema and animation resolution
- In scope: Phaser character rendering
- In scope: Opening dialogue branches
- In scope: Object action events and inventory
- In scope: Secret door object and save validation
- Out of scope: Backend or database changes
- Out of scope: New artwork
- Out of scope: Contribution modal and round header
- Preserve: Zustand store as single state owner
- Preserve: Existing save key worldseed:game-state:v1
- Preserve: Existing passing tests


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90.x
- localStorage only for persistence
- Content stays in game/src/content, runtime stays separate


## Definition of done
- All four requirements have Act and Verify units merged
- Unit tests green


## Non-functional requirements
- Corrupt saves never crash the game


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Boy and NPC characters are data-driven and animate idle, walk and interact from the manifest
nodes.body:
Context: bedroom.yaml has no characters; manifest has character:boy (idle), character:boy-walk, character:boy-interact; BootScene only loads image assets. Desired: a validated scene characters list, a pure animation resolver with idle fallback, preloading of spritesheets and Phaser sprites playing idle and interact on object click. Expected: boy shown idling, interact animation on click. Why: living scene, NPCs addable by content only.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a character spec with idle, walk and interact entries, when resolved against the manifest, then each returns that sheet's animation name
- Given a state with no matching entry or unknown asset, when resolved, then the idle animation is returned
- Given scene yaml with a characters list, when parsed by sceneSchema, then valid characters pass and a missing animations.idle fails with a path-named error
- Given an objectClick event, when BootScene handles it, then the boy plays interact then returns to idle


## Scope
- In scope: sceneSchema characters
- In scope: characterAnimation resolver
- In scope: planPreload character assets
- In scope: BootScene character sprites and anims
- Out of scope: Pathfinding movement
- Out of scope: New sprite art
- Preserve: Existing object rendering
- Preserve: planPreload dedupe behavior


## Technical constraints
- planPreload stays pure with no Phaser import
- Pixel-art settings unchanged


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- Boy defined in bedroom.yaml and animates
- NPC addable by yaml only


## Clarifying questions
- None

- Given a terminal choice, when chosen, then activeDialogue is null

nodes.title: REQ · Clicking bookshelf, computer, bed, window or door runs contextual actions updating flags, dialogue and inventory
nodes.body:
Context: only bookshelf search and computer search set flags; no action adds items, no action changes dialogue. Desired: bed search adds old-key, computer search sets computer_on and starts a dialogue, window inspect sets window_seen, door leave is conditional on hasItem old-key and sets door_unlocked. Expected: inventory and flags update via performAction. Why: interactions change real state.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the bed, when search is performed, then inventory contains old-key and a history line is added
- Given the computer, when search is performed, then flag computer_on is true
- Given the window, when inspect is performed, then flag window_seen is true
- Given no old-key, when door leave is attempted, then state is unchanged; with old-key it sets door_unlocked true
- Given bookshelf search, then secret_door_open is true


## Scope
- In scope: bedroom.yaml action events
- In scope: world.yaml flags
- Out of scope: New action ids beyond inspect, push, search, leave
- Preserve: Existing inspect texts
- Preserve: performAction semantics


## Technical constraints
- Action ids limited to the actionSchema enum


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- Five objects have state-changing actions


## Clarifying questions

nodes.title: REQ · Persistent object states survive save, restore and re-entering the room
nodes.body:
Context: persistence round-trips flags but deserializeState checks only container types, and no secret door object exists in the scene. Desired: a secret-door-open object visible when secret_door_open is true, and strict validation of array and record element types. Expected: door stays open after restore and after leaving and re-entering. Why: persistent world.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given secret_door_open true, when getSceneView runs, then secret-door-open is present; when false it is absent
- Given a saved state with the flag, when deserialized, then the flag remains true
- Given a save with non-string inventory items or non-boolean flags, when deserialized, then it throws and readSaved returns null
- Given goto_scene away and back, then flags and inventory are unchanged


## Scope
- In scope: secret-door-open object
- In scope: deserializeState element validation
- Out of scope: Server-side saves
- Preserve: Save key
- Preserve: serializeState format


## Technical constraints
- localStorage only, no database


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- Restore and re-entry keep the door open


## Non-functional requirements
- Corrupt saves fall back to a fresh game


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Add characterSchema with id, name, position {x,y}, scale default 1, layer default 'characters', animations record with required idle and optional walk and interact, each {asset: string, animation: string}; add optional characters array to sceneSchema; export CharacterSpec type.
steps.code: export const characterSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), name: z.string(), position: z.object({x:z.number(),y:z.number()}), scale: z.number().positive().default(1), layer: layerSchema.default('characters'), animations: z.object({ idle: animRef, walk: animRef.optional(), interact: animRef.optional() }) })
steps.expected: sceneSchema.parse accepts a characters list and rejects missing idle

steps.action: Add optional field characters?: CharacterSpec[] (import type from ../content/schema) to SceneDef.

Export resolveCharacterAnimation(spec: CharacterSpec, name: 'idle'|'walk'|'interact', manifest: AssetManifest): {asset: string; animation: string}. Use spec.animations[name]; if absent, or its asset is missing from manifest.assets or lacks that animation in asset.animations, return spec.animations.idle.
steps.expected: Returns idle ref for missing or unknown entries

steps.action: After the objects loop add a loop over scene.characters ?? [] adding every animations.*.asset id to refs.
steps.code: for (const c of scene.characters ?? []) for (const a of Object.values(c.animations)) if (a) refs.add(a.asset)

steps.action: In preload, for entries of type spritesheet call this.load.spritesheet(entry.id, `assets/${entry.path}`, {frameWidth: entry.frames.frameWidth, frameHeight: entry.frames.frameHeight}). In create, for each scene.characters entry register anims via this.anims.create keyed `${asset}:${animation}` from the manifest animation, add a sprite at position with origin from the manifest, play the idle key, and in the objectClick handler play interact then idle on animationcomplete.
steps.expected: Boy sprite idles and plays interact on click

steps.action: Add a characters list with id boy, name The Boy, position {x:150,y:140}, animations idle {asset: character:boy, animation: idle}, walk {asset: character:boy-walk, animation: walk}, interact {asset: character:boy-interact, animation: interact}.
